title: A dual expression plasmid with protegrin-1 compatible with both prokaryotic and mammalian systems✰✰✰
author: Murakami, Koda, et al.
materials: Cell culture and lipofection followed standard protocols [4]. HEK 293 cells (ATCC CRL1573; ATCC, Manassas, VA, USA) were maintained in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS). Transfection was performed using Lipofectamine (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA). The pgMAX-II/DsRed2/protegrin-1 plasmid was utilized directly for transient expression without further recombination. Bright red fluorescence was observed in HEK 293 cells 48 h post-transfection, confirming the utility of this novel construct as a single-step shuttle vector for both prokaryotic and mammalian systems (Fig. 2B, red arrows).

In conclusion, we successfully validated protegrin-1 as an effective selectable marker for plasmid recombination within the pgMAX-II system. Protegrin-1 achieved cloning efficiencies comparable to CcdB (Fig. 1A; Supplementary Fig. 1B). Furthermore, we demonstrated a dose-dependent increase in red fluorescence in response to IPTG. This novel framework enables simple, high-efficiency subcloning with dual-expression utility in both E. coli and mammalian cells.

steps.title: Transform ligated DNA into E. coli
steps.instruction: Thaw Turbo Competent E. coli (New England Biolabs, Ipswich, MA, USA) derived from the K12 strain with genotype [F’ proA+B+ lacIq ∆lacZM15 / fhuA2∆(lac-proAB)glnVgalK16galE15R(zgb-210::Tn10)TetS endA1thi-1∆(hsdS-mcrB)5]; add ligated plasmid DNA to 50 µL competent cells, incubate on ice 30 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, then add 950 µL pre‑warmed LB medium (Tryptone 10.0 g/L, Yeast extract 5.0 g/L, NaCl 5.0 g/L, pH 7.0) and recover for 1 h at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Plate recovered cells on selective agar
steps.instruction: Spread the recovered culture onto LB agar containing ampicillin at 150 µg/mL; incubate plates at 37 °C until single colonies appear.

steps.title: Grow single colonies for plasmid prep
steps.instruction: Pick individual colonies and inoculate each into 4 mL LB broth with ampicillin (150 µg/mL); incubate 12 h at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Harvest and purify plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Collect the overnight cultures, isolate plasmid DNA using an ion‑exchange mini kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Maintain HEK 293 cells
steps.instruction: Culture HEK 293 cells (ATCC CRL1573) in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, changing medium as needed.

steps.title: Transiently transfect HEK 293 cells
steps.instruction: Prepare transfection complexes using Lipofectamine (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA) and the pgMAX‑II/DsRed2/protegrin‑1 plasmid following the Lipofectamine protocol; add complexes to the cells and incubate.

steps.title: Assess expression after transfection
steps.instruction: Incubate transfected cells for 48 h, then examine under a fluorescence microscope for bright red fluorescence indicating successful expression of the construct.
